# Interactive Brokers

> Global online brokerage offering low-cost trading across stocks, options, futures, forex, bonds, ETFs, mutual funds, and alternative investments with advanced platforms and APIs.

Interactive Brokers (IBKR) is a leading global trading platform serving individual investors, institutional clients, family offices, and professional traders. The platform provides access to 90+ global markets with transparent pricing and comprehensive trading tools.

## Key Topics

- IBKR Trading API
- Global Markets
- Low Commissions
- Options Trading
- Futures Trading
- Currency Trading
- Stocks
- ETFs
- Bonds

## Trading Products & Services

- [Stock Trading](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/trading/products-stocks.php): Stock trading on 90+ global markets with low commissions
- [Options Trading](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/trading/products-options.php): Options trading tools and sophisticated strategies at IBKR
- [Futures Trading](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/trading/products-futures.php): Futures trading with comprehensive tools and education
- [Currency Trading](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/trading/products-spot-currencies.php): Currency trading with transparent low commissions and spreads
- [ETF Trading](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/trading/products-etfs.php): ETF trading products and services at Interactive Brokers
- [Fixed Income & Bonds](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/trading/products-bonds.php): Fixed income bonds marketplace with no markups or spreads
- [Mutual Funds](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/trading/products-mutual-funds.php): 40k+ mutual funds marketplace with no custody fees
- [US Spot Gold](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/trading/products-metals.php): US Spot Gold trading with physical delivery options
- [Hedge Fund Investing](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/trading/products-hedge-funds.php): Hedge fund investing for accredited investors via IBKR
- [Products & Exchanges Directory](https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/trading/products-exchanges.php): Searchable directory of securities, exchanges and contracts
